Running head at top right "De tabernaculo." with "Lib. 8." at top left of the text block. Page number 297 above the head. Main text in one column, with brace diagrams set in the text block, and marginal annotations ("ver.2", "ver.6", "ibid.4.5.6.7.", "Exod.26.14.36.") set to the right of the braces, and a brace diagram "Sequuntur" with a closing "eius." bracket.

main_text.head: Lib. 8.
main_text.p: Aulæa hæc, erant longitud. viginti octo cubitorum, & latitud.eorum,æquali mensura.ver.2.

Coniungebantur quinq; ver.6. vnum ad alterum
Loramentis.
Anfulis.
Loramenta, erant hyacinthina ab aulæis vno cū altero continentibus.ver.5.

Erant autem
In ora aulæi primi ad extremitate in cōmissura quinquaginta. ibid.4.5.6.7.
In ora cuiusq; aulæi vlteriore in cōmissura secunda.
Anfulæ,erant aureæ quinquaginta,quibus indebantur loramenta,vt aulæa ita inter se coniuncta sint in tabernaculum vnum.ver.6.

Significabat, ecclesiæ membra diuersa in cœlis & terra vnum tantum esse tabernaculum, vtcūq; inter se disperśa.Cant.6.6.Eph.4.8.9.Col.3.10.Eph.1.10.Heb.9.11. & 10.19.20. Apoc.21.3. inter se comparatis.

page.notes: Brace diagrams and the "Sequuntur"/"Teg. erat" bracket structures are rendered approximately as lines. Some words in the scan are blurred, notably "disperśa" (printed "disperfa") and the left-page edge fragments, which are not transcribed.
